content.intro: Use the interactive Boolean Builder below to construct structured search strings. Type your primary concepts and watch the syntax engine generate syntax-validated queries ready for Google Scholar, Scopus, Web of Science, and PubMed.
key: Always group your synonyms inside parentheses: (term1 OR term2 OR term3).
Connect separate conceptual dimensions using capital 'AND'.
Test your search string in multiple academic engines to verify recall and precision.
